scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @fluxrh/web" "npm run dev -w @fluxrh/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fluxrh/contracts && npm run build -w @fluxrh/api && npm run build -w @fluxrh/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fluxrh/api && npm run test -w @fluxrh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fluxrh/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @fluxrh/api && npm run typecheck -w @fluxrh/web
